senses.gloss: m. (= אנב׳, נבב to be hollow; cmp. בִּיב I) reed, flute; pipe, tube.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:3">Arakh. II, 3</cite> <he>א׳ של קנה</he> a reed flute, <he>א׳ של נחושת</he> brass flute.

Kel. II, 3; Men. X, 4 א׳ של קלאים Ar. (ed. קליות) an iron tube for roasting grain.—א׳ רוֹעֶה (Var. אבובראה, אבוברואה) shepherd’s flute, name of a plant (Eupatorium) used for medicinal purposes; v. חומטריא.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 14:3">Sabb. XIV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 109b">ib. 109ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. XIV, 14ᶜ
